popup.title: AIMailHelper
popup.provider.label: Provider: {provider}
options.title: AIMailHelper — Settings
options.provider.activeHint: Provider used for all AI tasks.
options.provider.apiKeyKeepHint: Leave empty to keep the saved key.
options.model.fetchFailed: Could not load the list — manual entry still works and saving is not blocked.
options.model.noFetchSupport: This provider doesn't support listing — enter the model manually.
options.model.anthropicCorsNote: The Anthropic list may be blocked by CORS (spike unverified) — enter manually on failure.
options.prompts.customHint: Leave empty to use the default prompt. The anti-injection clause is always appended.
options.automation.enableWarning: When enabled, the content of NEW emails will AUTOMATICALLY be sent to the LLM provider you configured for analysis and drafting. Drafts are only inserted after you approve them in the review queue; the extension will NEVER send emails by itself.
options.general.keyStorageSyncNote: Your API key is stored and synced through your Google account / Chrome Sync unless you choose "This device only" (chrome.storage.local).
options.general.keyStorageLocalNote: "This device only" keeps the key in chrome.storage.local — it never leaves this device.
options.general.privacyNote: Email content is only sent to the LLM endpoint you configure.
options.chat.hint: Chat goes through the active provider, streamed over the Port like the AI panel.
options.chat.needConfig: No active provider configured — save the configuration above first.
panel.title: AIMailHelper
panel.comingSoon: The AI panel becomes active in {phase}.
panel.consent.banner: First use: the content of emails you open will be sent to the LLM endpoint you configure for analysis.
errors.corsBlocked: Could not reach the provider (CORS). Check the endpoint/browser permissions.
errors.invalidKey: API key is invalid or lacks permission.
errors.rateLimited: Provider rate limit hit. Please retry later.
errors.timeout: Timed out waiting for the provider response.
errors.localProviderUnreachable: Cannot reach the local LLM. Check Ollama/LM Studio and the OLLAMA_ORIGINS guide.
errors.localOriginsHint: Ollama refused the connection. Set the environment variable OLLAMA_ORIGINS=chrome-extension://* and restart Ollama.
errors.owaNotFound: Could not locate the Outlook element (layout may have changed).
errors.streamInterrupted: The stream was interrupted. Received content is kept.
errors.streamFailed: The stream failed with an unexpected error. Please try again.
errors.storageQuota: Storage failed or is full. Clear the cache and retry.
errors.insertFailed: Could not insert the draft into the compose box. Copy it from the preview.
errors.emptyEmail: The email is empty or unreadable.
errors.missingConfig: A required configuration field is missing.
errors.missingMessageId: Could not determine the message-id of the email.
errors.hostPermission: The extension lacks permission for this host. Grant it in Options.
errors.badRequest: The request is invalid or was rejected by the provider.
errors.providerOverloaded: The provider is overloaded. It will retry automatically.
errors.contentFilter: Content was blocked by the provider's filter.
errors.safetyBlocked: Content was blocked by the model's safety policy.
errors.modelsNotSupported: This provider doesn't support model listing — enter the model manually.
errors.tooLarge: Content is too long — shorten it and retry.
